kitchen-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.source: We check the base, moisture-exposed junctions and proposed kitchen layout before agreeing preparation and any specified waterproofing. If you are replacing a benchtop or retaining cabinets, tell us what stays and where dampness appears. Cabinetry, appliance access and final tiled surfaces need a coordinated sequence; a splashback update alone does not establish the need for a new floor membrane.
kitchen-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.target: 确认基层准备及指定防水前，我们检查基层、受潮交接和拟定厨房布局。更换台面或保留橱柜时，请说明保留内容及潮湿位置。橱柜、设备通行和最终瓷砖需协调工序；仅更新防溅墙不能说明需要新地面防水膜。
交接处与装置周边细部处理

kitchen-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.source: Waterproofing coordinated with the kitchen finish
kitchen-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.target: 与厨房饰面协调的防水

kitchen-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.source: Retained cabinets, appliances and wet junction preparation
kitchen-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.target: 保留橱柜、设备与湿区交接准备

kitchen-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.source: A kitchen repair needs a clear boundary between the area that can be opened and fittings that remain. Tell us whether cabinets, the benchtop and flooring stay in place, and whether a dishwasher or other appliance is being replaced. Hidden areas beneath fixed cabinetry may not be accessible without additional removal; we agree that access before including the work. Dampness near an appliance can have a supply or drainage source, so a membrane is not selected simply because the floor is wet.
kitchen-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.target: 厨房维修需明确可打开区域与保留装置的边界。请说明橱柜、台面和地面是否保留，洗碗机等设备是否更换。固定柜下隐蔽区域可能需额外拆除才能接近，我们先确认通行再纳入范围。设备旁潮湿可能来自供排水，不能仅因地面有水就选择防水膜。

kitchen-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.source: Floor protection and splashback installation are different scopes
kitchen-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.target: 地面防护与防溅墙安装属于不同范围

kitchen-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.source: A splashback protects a wall finish from everyday splashes; replacing it is a separate task from preparing a moisture-exposed floor and its junctions. We check the existing substrate, transitions at doorways and how the proposed membrane meets retained surfaces. Loose tiles or damaged material may need removal before the base can be assessed. The quote identifies the accessible boundary and any excluded cabinetry, appliance or separate plumbing work.
kitchen-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.target: 防溅墙保护墙面免受日常溅水，其更换与受潮地面及交接准备是不同任务。我们检查现有基层、门口过渡及拟用膜层与保留表面的衔接。松砖或损坏材料可能需先拆除才能检查基层。报价明确可接触边界，以及排除的橱柜、设备或独立管道工作。

kitchen-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.source: Tell us where moisture appears and whether cabinets, appliances and flooring will remain. A supply or waste leak needs attention separately from waterproofing.
kitchen-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.target: 请说明潮湿位置及橱柜、设备、地面是否保留。供排水渗漏需与防水分别处理。

kitchen-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.source: We agree access beneath or beside retained fittings and the membrane-to-tile sequence.
kitchen-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.target: 我们确认保留装置下方或旁边的通行，以及防水到贴砖的工序。

kitchen-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.source: Kitchen wet-zone preparation and compatible layers
kitchen-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.target: 厨房涉水部位的基层与配套防水层

kitchen-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.source: We define the kitchen areas included in the waterproofing scope before selecting materials. The base, sink-side junctions, penetrations and planned finish determine the compatible primer, membrane and detailing. An epoxy moisture barrier has a different role from a flexible under-tile membrane; an easy-clean splashback or epoxy grout does not replace that membrane. Separate plumbing work remains identified in the quote.
kitchen-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.target: 我们先明确厨房防水包含的区域，再选配材料。基层、水槽旁交接、穿管及拟定饰面，决定相容的底涂、防水膜和节点做法。环氧防潮阻隔层与柔性瓷砖下防水膜作用不同，易清洁防溅墙或环氧填缝也不能代替防水膜。独立水管工程仍在报价中另行明确。

kitchen-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.target: 检查受影响区域，确认通行、受潮规律及适用性。

kitchen-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.source: Agree an itemised written quote covering preparation, materials, boundaries, finish and exclusions.
kitchen-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.target: 以分项书面报价确认准备、材料、边界、饰面及排除内容。

kitchen-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.source: Prepare the accessible base and carry out the agreed work, with checks appropriate to the selected system.
kitchen-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.target: 处理可接触基层并完成约定施工，按所选系统开展相应检查。

kitchen-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.source: Explain curing, return to use and care at handover. Timing follows the materials and site conditions.
kitchen-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.target: 交付时说明养护、恢复使用与保养，时间依材料及现场条件确定。
